'''2010 Malastare Regionals Jonathan Murray LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Net Deck
* '''Username:''' Throdo
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
